theme: An open day that ends on the 3:16 south to Washington.
greeting: Most of today is yours, Dan — an East Hampton morning, then the train down to Washington, with a late flight on to Bangor tomorrow night. The Japan board search is running on its own schedule, so nothing here is chasing you.

schedule.title: Train to Washington, DC
schedule.detail: Amtrak from Penn Station, in around 6:15.

flagged.title: Japan board call set for Aug 19
flagged.detail: JOMON's Mr. Furuta is confirmed for a Zoom Wednesday, Aug 19 at 8:00 PM ET — the ProNed thank-you to Sakai-san went out this morning.

inbox.noise: The rest is newsletters and retail promos — NYT Cooking, Morgan Stanley and Amex offers, Mattress Firm, a campaign blast or two.
inbox.clear: No security, financial, or health mail needing you.

resolved: Sent your thank-you to Sakai-san, closing the loop on last month's ProNed board conversation.
Cleared the Vinalhaven sconce lights that had lingered since Aug 7.

recipe.title: Cold avocado & cucumber soup
recipe.why: A cold, silky bowl for a hot travel day — cucumbers are at their August peak and it asks nothing of you at the end of a train ride south.

acts.line: An open morning — nothing was on the calendar before the train.
Amtrak from New York down to Washington, DC (in around 6:16).
Arrive in DC — the evening is your own.
